To create an empty shell script at `/workspace/system_maintenance.sh` with execute permissions, you can use the following commands:

```bash

chmod +x /workspace/system_maintenance.sh
```

To write the specified content to `/workspace/system_maintenance.sh`, you can use the following command:


This command will overwrite the existing content of the script with the new content provided.
Final Turn: Execute the system maintenance script using: python -c "import os; os.system('bash /workspace/system_maintenance.sh')"

To execute the system maintenance script using Python, you can run the following command:

